rationale: The assistant immediately identified normal cooling-fan run-on, asked exactly the right discriminating check ('Note whether it stops by itself after a few minutes') and listed sensible red flags (runs indefinitely, runs when unused, burning smell, harsh noise). Confirmed as normal once the customer reported it stops by itself and runs longest after grill/oven, matching the hidden truth, with no fabricated evidence and a correct warning not to remove the casing. Only minor shortfall: given a 2-month-old appliance, pointing to Samsung warranty rather than a generic 'microwave engineer' would have been the better fallback escalation.
